title: OSBAPI OSCAL CRM Interoperability Schema Suite

control_id.description: Control identifier such as AC-2 or SC-7.

oscal_implementation_status.description: Raw OSCAL SSP implementation-status.state value (fismatic/python-ssp vocabulary, e.g. 'partially-implemented', 'alternative-implementation', 'customer-configured'), preserved verbatim alongside the coarser OSBAPI implementation_status enum so OSCAL is retained as the lossless interoperability/storage format and no distinction made in the source SSP is silently discarded.

oscal_origination.description: Raw OSCAL SSP control-origination list (fismatic/python-ssp vocabulary, e.g. ['inherited', 'hybrid']), preserved verbatim alongside the single collapsed OSBAPI origination enum. A control may legitimately have multiple origination flags set simultaneously in the source SSP; this field retains all of them.

component_ref.description: Pointer or logical ref to OSCAL component definition UUID or URI.

media_files.description: Attachment filenames (under Diagrams/media/) extracted from the source .docx and embedded in the note body via Obsidian ![[...]] syntax.

VaultExtensionNarrativeFrontmatter.description: Generic oscal.x.* narrative note frontmatter recovered from SSP Chapters 1-12 by the contract-driven heading_parser (boundary, relationship, inheritance, runbook, decision). type/extension_model/note_type are not const-locked here because a single builder emits several extension_models from the same shape; the per-model concrete schemas (e.g. VaultExtensionDiagramFrontmatter) remain authoritative for their model.
